data.description:
## Context
Story 0289 landed the S3 multi-bundle auto-doctor with a self-contained iterated 2-parent merge in src/rebar/_store/s3_doctor.py::_fold_heads (the plan permitted this fallback to avoid risking sync's oracle). rebar's backend-agnostic divergent-head healer already lives in src/rebar/_store/sync.py (_do_reconverge per-target decision + _union_merge 2-parent merge). The two now duplicate the lossless-merge policy.

## Goal
Factor sync.py's per-target decision + 2-parent merge into ONE shared reconcile_one(tracker, target_ref) primitive; sync calls it once, the S3 doctor calls it per bundle head. Behaviour-preserving.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] A shared reconcile_one primitive exists; both sync.reconverge and s3_doctor._fold_heads route through it (no duplicated merge/unrelated-history logic).
- [ ] sync's existing tests and the S3 doctor's happy + held-out tests all remain GREEN.
- [ ] No new merge=union driver; no new core dependency.
data.title: Generalize divergent-head healing: share reconcile_one across sync and the S3 doctor
